name: slide_page
title: Create Slidev page
description: Generates a skeleton page for one layout under pages/ of the talk-dir, and returns the specification of that layout (props / text_constraints / clicks / best_practices / anti_patterns / examples). The specification is returned in reference and includes. Decide the presentation style from the categories (categories) in the slide_create / slide_sync response, then choose the layout name from layouts of that category (passing an unknown name returns categories and layouts in the response). The generated page must be registered separately as a src: entry in slides.md.

layout.description: Layout name. Decide the presentation style from the categories (categories) in the slide_create / slide_sync response, then choose from the names in layouts that belong to that category

dir.description: Absolute path of the talk-dir to generate the page in. Relative paths are not accepted. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

file.description: File name to generate directly under pages/ (.md may be omitted). Names with path separators or starting with a digit are not accepted

force.description: Overwrite when a page with the same name already exists

event.description: slide.page.done on success, slide.page.error on failure (omitted when a path argument is rejected)

layout.description: Layout name of the generated page (success only)

category.description: Category ID of the layout (success only)

deprecated.description: Whether the layout is deprecated (success only)

path.description: Absolute path of the written page (success only)

skeleton.description: Frontmatter written to the page (success only)

reference.description: Full text of the reference yaml of the layout (success only)

includes.description: Full text of the shared yaml files the reference yaml includes, keyed by name (success only; empty when none)

id.description: Category ID that layouts[].category refers to

question.description: Question that tells when to choose the category

categories.description: Presentation categories declared by the theme (failure only, kind unknown-layout)

category.description: Category ID (uncategorized when unset or unknown)

deprecated.description: Whether the layout is deprecated (not to be chosen)

filename.description: File name of the reference yaml

layouts.description: Selectable layouts (hidden layouts are excluded) (failure only, kind unknown-layout)

invalidPaths.description: Rejected path arguments as <parameter>=<value> (failure only, kind invalid-path)

convertedPaths.description: Windows-style path arguments converted before the rejection, keyed by parameter name (failure only, kind invalid-path; omitted when nothing was converted)

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of the command or child process (failure only). Over 64KB, the end is kept and the first line notes the truncation

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run (omitted when there are none). Beyond 100 warnings or 64KB, the last item tells how many were omitted
